body:
Trimmed down as discussed in #351. This keeps the credits skipping and rewind behavior from #329.

Adds an auto-skip credits option, off by default and saved for the current profile on this TV. Credits need a valid start and end time. Playback jumps to the end of the credits so anything after them can still play. Incomplete markers still use the manual skip button. Changing streams turns off automatic skipping for the rest of that playback.

Rewinding cancels the Next countdown and stops that section being skipped again, even if its markers arrive later. The Next button still works. Auto-next waits for playback to catch up after a seek.

This uses the shared player and keeps the existing seek/pause calls. Samsung's playback-completed flag is now passed through so auto-next can tell when playback has ended. The new setting has English fallback text in each language file.

The credits, rewind, profile settings and Samsung bridge tests pass. Translation checks and ARM64/ARMv7 syntax checks pass too.

Leaving this as a draft because the 2.0.4 changes mentioned in #351 aren't on public master yet. I haven't run full app builds, the full test suite or TV playback tests.
title: Skip credits and cancel auto-next on rewind (#329)
